findings.detail: Salla intake calls upsert_order(source=salla_direct,raw=original provider payload). Raw snapshot is retained in unified_orders.raw_by_source.salla_direct; raw.date or raw.created_at is the source creation time. Bind raw.id/reference_id to owner-scoped order_id/order_number before trusting its timestamp or items.

findings.area: Local observation clocks are not order creation
findings.detail: updated_at/data_sources.at/last_salla_direct_sync_at are local write/observation clocks; received_at is local first ingestion. Make payloads without a date use current Riyadh day and order_date_inferred=true. Never use these local clocks to assign sales windows.

findings.area: Normalized day is not sufficient boundary proof
findings.detail: _normalize_date removes positive offset/Z and takes date without converting the instant to Riyadh. Date first-writer/fill-empty rules can preserve an older normalized value; inferred-date override needs explicit raw/date flags. order_date_inferred=false alone does not prove correct Riyadh boundary. A bounded normalized-day query is only candidate discovery.

_salla_business_date/unified_order_date_evidence prefer preserved Salla date then created_at, convert explicit offsets or date-object timezone into Riyadh and return provenance. Order Engine _parse_datetime normalizes source timestamps to aware UTC and rejects absent creation date in its mapper. Existing fallbacks default naive/malformed timezone to Riyadh or accept normalized order_date, so a future high-assurance evidence adapter needs a stricter proof contract; do not blindly promote those fallback results.

Canonical rows retain source order-item ID, product/parent IDs, variant ID and SKU. Generic current-catalog resolver includes SKU/name fallback and indexes aliases into overwriteable dictionaries; it is appropriate for existing display/cost compatibility, not independent verified order-product attribution. Exact raw item/parent IDs and unique source-item identities must drive new evidence. Preserve actual quantity=2 and repeated distinct source rows; never dedupe by product or SKU.

findings.area: Current cost quality versus historical cost
findings.detail: Current mezan_product_cost_profiles_v2 stores base/variant costs and updated_at; variant overrides base, explicit zero is valid, Salla fallback remains separate from explicit Mezan cost. These current values are not a historical sale-cost ledger. Global product-cost revision helps detect changes to current-cost observations but is not sale-time cost proof.

mezan_order_item_cost_snapshots_v2 is owner/order/item scoped and retains source_item_id, product identities, quantity, base/option/component amounts, cost_complete/mezan_cost_complete/uses_salla_fallback/calculated_at. Rebuild overwrites the snapshot using current profiles and writes Mongo; it is not immutable historical sale cost and must never be called from a read-only evidence adapter. Read individual flags/line amounts; GET total substitutes missing values with zero and cannot establish complete economics.

Read-only bundle order_view distinguishes expected_cost versus actual_cost, quantity, frozen revision and reconciliation_required. Actual requires leaves with actual costs. A bundle remains one sale line; component consumption is not additional product sales. Do not count expected cost as actual or add parent cost to leaf cost.

order_amount_to_sar uses exact stored order FX; unavailable foreign FX remains unknown. Native order currency and current cost currency must remain distinct. Product quantity evidence is not revenue/profit evidence; discounts, returns, tax, shipping, payment/BNPL fees and ad-cost allocation are not established by merely finding a base cost.

proposed_contract.scope: Bounded owner-only diagnostic observations for pinned numeric Salla products in a saved commercial-plan revision; no ranking, complete-sales totals, profit or campaign execution
proposed_contract.request: Server principal supplies owner_id. Client may supply plan_id and expected_revision only. Server clock fixes as_of and closed Riyadh business-day windows. Re-read saved revision/fields after reads; no client-submitted source facts or verified flags.
proposed_contract.window_discovery: For each closed target window, use at most the union of order_date in [window_start minus 1 day, window_end plus 1 day] as a coarse indexed candidate query. Use explicit inclusion projection and a bounded limit+1 (example design 5001 for a server bound of 5000). Resolve every included order from its preserved raw source timestamp and filter its exact Riyadh business date into the requested window. The plus/minus-one-day expansion does not prove no orders are missed: normalized date drift, unsupported source timezone, missing rows and earlier first-writer values remain coverage limitations.

priority: raw_by_source.salla_direct.date.date + its explicit IANA timezone (or embedded offset/Z)
timestamp_exact.rule: Bind raw source identity to owner/order first; parse full instant, preserve original raw timestamp/source timezone, normalize to aware UTC, then derive Asia/Riyadh business date. An explicit offset is authoritative. A date-only value can be labelled business_date_only, never upgraded to exact instant; a naive timestamp requires separately proven source timezone. Invalid/missing/contradictory timestamp or timezone becomes unknown. Never substitute ingestion/update times.

proposed_contract.product_match: Read only projected source items, bind unique raw item ID to exact normalized source_item_id/order_item_id, resolve explicit parent/product ID to selected product. A variant alias requires exactly one catalog parent and source-variant proof. Generic item.id is an order-line ID, not a product-ID shortcut. SKU/name-only, contradictory parent IDs or duplicate variant mappings are ambiguous and excluded from verified matches.
proposed_contract.metrics: Return observed_matched_order_count and observed_units only as diagnostic observations with explicit subset scope. Deduplicate order count by (owner,order_number,selected_product_id); sum quantities of distinct proven source item IDs, preserving quantity=2. Do not label these counts total sales or conversions. Native-money observations remain per currency and period. Do not send incomplete observations into ProductSourceRecord.verified_orders because that field explicitly requires complete store-order proof.
proposed_contract.cost_observation: Read matching saved snapshots/current profiles only; validate exact owner/order/source-item/product/variant/quantity and cost flags. Describe current_profile, recomputed_snapshot, bundle_expected or bundle_actual basis with timestamp/reference. Incomplete/mismatched/unverifiable currency or option/component costs stay unknown; no profit or ROAS is computed. Do not call calculate_order_cost_snapshot, ensure_indexes, sync, rebuild or any source writer.
proposed_contract.coverage: Return coverage_status=unknown/partial (or truncated) and complete=false unless a separately verified source coverage watermark proves the entire exact order range and all unresolved retries. Finite cursor exhaustion is not provider completeness. Auto-sync recent reconciliation, global last_sync_at or one successful report is not that watermark. Mark current absence as not_observed, never zero sales.
proposed_contract.read_consistency: The existing intake has scoped transaction/fences but no verified global order-evidence snapshot generation for the requested window. Plan revision recheck and row hashes detect some changes, not all concurrent insertions or a consistent multi-row source snapshot. Keep that limitation explicit; do not claim atomic historical completeness.
not_in_scope: Converting provider-attributed conversions into store-order totals

acceptance_tests_proposed: Riyadh midnight: raw timestamp 2026-08-14T21:30:00Z resolves to 2026-08-15; normalized order_date 2026-08-14 only discovers candidate, never controls final window.
Date object with Asia/Riyadh wall clock resolves to the same UTC instant as its offset/Z representation; explicit offset overrides a conflicting default; unsupported/invalid timezone fails closed.
Local received_at/updated_at/created_at changes never move an order into a new sales window.
Missing raw timestamp, inferred day, date-only value or naive timestamp without proven timezone yields explicit unknown/exactness limitation.
Conflicting raw.id/reference_id versus owner-scoped canonical identity rejects source proof; cross-tenant rows never contribute.
Coarse plus/minus-one-day candidates outside the exact Riyadh window are excluded; limit+1 truncation is explicit and never complete=true.
Empty candidate query with no provider coverage watermark returns not_observed and complete=false, not zero sales or known negative growth.
Source-created day drift beyond coarse range remains a documented coverage gap; cursor exhaustion never removes that gap.
Exact source-item mapping accepts product and parent identities; SKU/name-only matches or duplicate variant parents remain ambiguous.
Two distinct source item IDs for same product plus quantity=2 are preserved; product-level order count stays one.
Missing/partial cost, Salla fallback, explicit zero, variant override and quantity mismatch are classified distinctly without fabricated profit.
Snapshot rebuilt after sale is labelled recomputed/current basis, not immutable sale-time cost; no rebuild/update/ensure-index functions invoked.
Bundle expected and actual costs stay distinct; component consumption adds no sale units or extra parent cost.
Foreign order FX absent stays unknown; native currency is preserved and not relabelled SAR.
Concurrent plan revision/field change invalidates result; repeat row observations do not establish a global source snapshot/watermark.
Instrumented fake DB/network clients reject insert/update/delete/create_index/provider calls during the diagnostic read; owner-only route contract maintained.
